segment.source: Um, I'll stay here. Tried to escape before - seven times even! But they always find me and dump me back in here.<end>
segment.target: Um, I'll stay here. Tried to escape before - seven times even! But they always find me and dump me back in here.<end>

segment.source: You shouldn't be here! Hmm, when I think about it - I shouldn't be here!<end>
segment.target: You shouldn't be here! Hmm, when I think about it - I shouldn't be here!<end>

segment.source: These walls are funny. First you hate 'em, then you get used to 'em. Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them. That's institutionalized.<end>
segment.target: These walls are funny. First you hate 'em, then you get used to 'em. Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them. That's institutionalized.<end>

segment.source: ::Yawns.:: Damn, I lost track of how long I've been stuck in this joint.<end>
segment.target: ::Yawns.:: Damn, I lost track of how long I've been stuck in this joint.<end>

segment.source: Seen my pet mouse anywhere? Mr. Giggles! Mr. Giggles! Where are you?<end>
segment.target: Seen my pet mouse anywhere? Mr. Giggles! Mr. Giggles! Where are you?<end>

segment.source: Hey, $(#dude/gal). Got a cigar? A rasp? A pistol?<end>
segment.target: Hey, $(#dude/gal). Got a cigar? A rasp? A pistol?<end>

segment.source: Name's Abseenth. Like the drink, only not spelled the same. ::Laughs.::<end>
segment.target: Name's Abseenth. Like the drink, only not spelled the same. ::Laughs.::<end>

segment.source: ::Spits on the floor.:: Whatcha lookin' at? I can do whatever I like in my cell! It's mine! Mine!<end>
segment.target: ::Spits on the floor.:: Whatcha lookin' at? I can do whatever I like in my cell! It's mine! Mine!<end>

segment.source: I'm innocent! I've been telling them that every damn time they dump me back in 'ere!<end>
segment.target: I'm innocent! I've been telling them that every damn time they dump me back in 'ere!<end>

segment.source: Damn, I think I'm losing my hair...<end>
